gate.title: A digital gateway for your destination
gate.text: Publish destination content, run campaigns, understand visitor interest and support your tourism businesses, all in one place.
gate.demoNote: The demo account belongs to a fictional organisation, “Demo Tourism Board · Tanzania”. It does not represent any real authority, and its figures are sample data.
gate.noAccount: Represent a tourism board, DMO, park or conservation organisation?

overview.title: Welcome, {{name}}
overview.text: {{org}}: destination interest, campaigns and content at a glance.
overview.demoNote: Demo organisation. Figures marked as sample data are generated for illustration and are not official statistics.
overview.sampleNote: applies to visitor interest and 360° views.

destinations.text: The destinations in your area. Edit their content and publish updates to TravelMateVR.
destinations.interestNote: Visitor interest is an index of destination page views, 360° views and searches over 12 months (sample data).
destinations.editText: Update the description, safety and responsible-travel guidance and the best months to visit. Published changes appear on the public page straight away.
destinations.accuracy: You're responsible for the accuracy of published information. Link safety and entry guidance to official sources where possible.
destinations.published: Published. The public destination page is updated.
destinations.draftNote: Unpublished draft saved {{date}}. Travellers still see the previous version.
destinations.managePosts: Updates and events for this destination

content.text: News, events, travel alerts and stories shown on destination pages under “Updates from the destination”.
content.errTitle: Add a title of at least 4 characters.
content.errBody: Add at least 20 characters of text.
content.alertNote: Travel alerts appear first on the destination page. Use them for safety, access or closures, and link to the official source in the text.
content.publishNote: Published updates appear on the public destination page in the language you write them in, with a label naming your organisation.
content.emptyText: Publish news, events or travel alerts for your destinations.

campaigns.text: Promote destinations to the markets and interests you choose, across TravelMateVR.
campaigns.note: Campaign content is labelled as promoted by your organisation. TravelMateVR reviews campaigns before they start.

visitors.text: Where interest in your destinations comes from, and what travellers look for.
visitors.interestDef: Interest combines destination page views, 360° views and searches.
visitors.searchesNote: Searches mentioning your destinations, in the language travellers typed them.

attractions.text: How each destination and immersive experience performs.
attractions.captureTip_one: {{count}} experience still uses a panoramic preview. Real 360° captures keep travellers exploring longer.
attractions.captureTip_other: {{count}} experiences still use a panoramic preview. Real 360° captures keep travellers exploring longer.

trends.text: Seasonality, length of stay and booking behaviour across your area.
trends.seasonalityNote: Share of your destinations in their best months, by month.

partners.text: Tourism businesses on TravelMateVR in your area.
partners.note: Businesses marked “Sample listing” are fictional and demonstrate the marketplace. Invite real businesses in your area to apply.

sustainability.text: Contributions, certifications and community benefit across your area.
sustainability.dataNote: Contributions are summed from bookings in the demo (including sample guests). Certification shares come from listing data.
sustainability.claims: Sustainability claims are shown only when partners provide evidence. Boards can publish guidance on destination pages.

landing.title: A digital gateway to your destination
landing.lede: For tourism boards, DMOs, government tourism authorities, national parks and conservation organisations: publish, promote and understand your destination on TravelMateVR.
landing.forText: One dashboard to manage how your destination is presented and to see what travellers are looking for.

content.d: Keep destination descriptions, safety guidance and best seasons up to date, and publish news, events and alerts.

campaigns.d: Promote destinations to the source markets and traveller interests you choose.

interest.d: See demand by month, market and interest, and what travellers search for.

attractions.d: Compare destinations and 360° experiences by views, engagement and bookings.

partners.d: Understand the tourism businesses in your area and invite new ones.

sustainability.d: Track contributions, certifications and community-led tourism.

landing.message: What would you like to achieve?
landing.messagePh: Destinations you manage, markets you focus on, timing…
landing.subject: Tourism board enquiry
landing.sent: Thank you. Your request {{id}} has reached our partnerships team; we reply within two working days.
